app.name: Old Man Burn
app.short_description: Arcade edition: a new road every week
app.long_description:
Born in 1952 and still riding. Hold the throttle to keep up with the road, but not so long you shoot off the front. A new road every week, and a top ten with three-letter initials, kept on the SD card.
Wii Remote sideways: hold 2 to go, the D-pad steers. Nunchuk: hold B or Z, the stick steers. Classic Controller and GameCube controller: hold A or R.
Hold - (or HOME, or Z on a GameCube controller) on the title screen for the settings.
